mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment claims (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points in the next month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.3pp in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE exceeding the threshold, or the trigger condition is not met.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and a drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 7.0% signals dual easing, which amplifies equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction does not occur as predicted (FEDFUNDS not below 0.1 or UNRATE not below 7.0), or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained high GDP growth (GDPC1) and low unemployment (PAYEMS) create momentum in equity markets, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not late-cycle, or the combination of GDPC1 and PAYEMS does not drive significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05 over 60 days).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above its 5-year trend signals robust economic growth, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not trend upward sufficiently (e.g., growth rate below 2% quarterly) or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in industrial production (HOUST) above 1100 units in the next month reflects strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST does not exceed 1100 or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward trends in GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (HOUST) above their respective 3-month moving averages signal robust demand, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: The moving averages are not exceeded, or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05 over 60 days).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE) above 7.0% signal restrictive policy, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not tightening, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and UNRATE does not result in negative returns (t-test p > 0.05).
